name: Ship Desk
tagline: Write code all day, review it overnight, start clean tomorrow.
description: The overnight engineering loop. You ship features with Grimoire during the day, PR Desk reviews every diff while you sleep, and Agent Looper fixes what it can before your standup. Morning you reviews a clean changelog instead of a wall of notifications.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Scaffold and implement with Grimoire — small diffs, honest tradeoffs, boring stack.

steps.name: Review
steps.text: Paste the day's diffs into PR Desk before logging off; it returns correctness-first comments overnight.

steps.name: Fix
steps.text: Feed accepted fixes to Agent Looper to run implement → test → fix loops and write the changelog.

name: Inbox & Calendar Desk
tagline: Email, calendar, and meetings — one morning loop instead of three apps.
description: The daily coordination desk. Dewey sorts the inbox down to what needs you, Chief of Staff turns that plus your calendar into a three-priority plan, and Meeting Scribe converts whatever meetings happen into decisions and follow-ups. Run it every morning and nothing falls through.

steps.name: Triage
steps.text: Paste the overnight inbox into Dewey — it shelves everything into NEEDS YOU / FYI / ARCHIVE.

steps.name: Plan
steps.text: Give Chief of Staff Dewey's NEEDS YOU list plus your calendar; it drafts replies and picks your three priorities.

steps.name: Close
steps.text: After meetings, paste notes into Meeting Scribe for decisions, owners, and the follow-up email.

name: Money Hunters
tagline: Find the money, chase the invoices, stop the leaks.
description: A quarterly money sweep. Bounty Hunter finds refunds and claims you're owed, Subscription Auditor kills the zombie charges, and Invoice Hunter runs the follow-up sequence on what clients owe you. One hour per quarter, real dollars back.

steps.name: Claim
steps.text: Paste your purchase history into Bounty Hunter — send the drafted claim emails ranked by payout ÷ effort.

steps.name: Cut
steps.text: Run your bank statement through Subscription Auditor and kill everything in the KILL column.

steps.name: Collect
steps.text: Give Invoice Hunter your aging receivables; send today's escalation email for each.

name: Research Desk
tagline: From open question to cited brief to 'so what'.
description: The analyst pipeline. Deep Research Intern takes the question and returns a cited brief, Paper Explainer handles the one paper that actually matters, and Fact Checker verifies the claims before they go in front of your boss or your audience. Receipts at every step.

steps.name: Brief
steps.text: Hand the open question to Deep Research Intern — findings first, sources per claim, disagreements called out.

steps.name: Go deep
steps.text: For the key source, Paper Explainer gives you claim / method / results / limits in five paragraphs.

steps.name: Verify
steps.text: Before you publish or present, Fact Checker scores every claim and flags the one most likely to embarrass you.

name: Sales Desk
tagline: Prospect, write, review — the full outbound loop in one sitting.
description: Founder-led sales in one loop. Pipeline Prospector builds the ICP-matched list with trigger events, Cold Mail Closer writes the sub-90-word emails, and Deal Reviewer keeps your pipeline honest with MEDDPICC interviews. One evening a week covers the whole funnel.

steps.name: List
steps.text: Describe your ICP to Pipeline Prospector; confirm the profile, then get prospects with trigger events and why-them sentences.

steps.name: Write
steps.text: Feed each prospect to Cold Mail Closer — three ranked angles, two-step follow-ups, zero AI slop.

steps.name: Qualify
steps.text: For live deals, run the Deal Reviewer interview and get a score, the weakest section, and three questions for your champion.

bestFor: Agencies filling the top of funnel

name: Study Desk
description: For exam season and skill sprints. Study Buddy drills you with spaced repetition on your own material, Paper Explainer translates the hard sources, and Fact Checker keeps your essay citations honest. The loop works for certifications, classes, and self-teaching.

steps.name: Drill
steps.text: Paste your material into Study Buddy; it builds a deck and re-quizzes what you miss at spaced intervals.

steps.name: Understand
steps.text: For the readings that won't click, Paper Explainer translates every equation and flags overclaims.

steps.name: Cite
steps.text: Before submitting, Fact Checker grades each claim in your draft so your sources actually check out.
